TOOL RESULT: # Running DiffusionGemma Locally on CPU

## Build Instructions

Clone the specific llama.cpp PR and build for CPU:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp
cd llama.cpp
gh pr checkout 24423
cmake -B build -DGGML_CUDA=OFF
cmake --build build -j --config Release --target llama-diffusion-cli
```

The documentation specifies: "Obtain the SPECIFIC `llama.cpp` PR on GitHub here" (PR #24423). For CPU-only inference, omit the `-DGGML_CUDA=ON` flag.

## Running DiffusionGemma

```bash
./build/bin/llama-diffusion-cli \
  -m path/to/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it-Q8_0.gguf \
  -ngl 0 -cnv -n 2048
```

Key parameters for CPU:
- `-ngl 0`: CPU-only inference (no GPU layer offloading)
- `-cnv`: Multi-turn conversation mode
- `-n 2048`: Target token count
